original.address_system: Ghidra NE-loader source addresses; execution segments are fixture relocations, not runtime DPMI selectors
original.method: Unicorn executes original Ghidra-exported whole scheduler functions and native compiler memcpy, controlled clock/callback/allocator boundaries; PIT and stopwatch instruction vectors separately
limitations: Not a complete DOS/DPMI run; controlled clock samples and callback bodies.
No GBA or NDS scheduler serves as expected-value oracle.
Allocator-free boundary records frees without releasing fixture storage.
Unsafe current-owner destruction/empty-owner activation are ASM findings, not safe conformance vectors.

independent_core_review.scope: Current core and header hashes match the independent review snapshot; stress invariants are not a native conformance oracle.

native_preserved: Unsigned deadline >= comparison including early/late rollover anomalies and negative interval bit patterns.
Owner ring insertion order, event insertion order, live append and shrinking owner-count bound.
Copy read slot into compacted write slot before callback; update source/read deadline after callback.
Set interval changes array[0], not currently executing source slot.
Re-read clock after callback, repeat from now_after+interval without missed-period catchup.
Native constructor capacity4 admits3 events; clear preserves registered owner identities.
explicit_adaptations: Logical object refs and callback IDs replace DOS far pointers; adapter explicitly passes parameter/context.
Deferred current-owner destroy and pending activation of preregistered empty owners prevent native UAF/cursor corruption.
Register/reset/clear/reentrant dispatch and callback-local helpers outside their valid phase are rejected.
One dispatch(0) sweep: mid-dispatch uint32 wrap does not repeat native busy wait. Dedicated shared regression verifies one sweep, four reads and empty ring.
Exact monotonic rational clock with fraction and explicit pause/resume replaces PIT I/O/truncation/reset-phase discontinuities.
limitations: No complete gameplay loop, actors or input/movement integration yet; N09 onward own actual service cadence.
Same explicit dispatch/clock timeline is independent of render observations; arbitrary changes to native polling samples are not equivalent. No update60 or GBA100tick grid introduced.
512 owners is bounded NDS storage, not a recovered native world limit. Actor/projectile pools must preregister owners or defer creation until sweep end.
Native unsafe lifetime paths and mid-dispatch rollover are intentional corrections, not exact original conformance.
SDK timer2 IRQ must be serviced within a full low16 overflow period (~125ms); real IRQ latency/quartz/FPS/hardware deferred to N24.
Short emulator run observes many low16 rollovers, not natural uint32/uint64 SDK uptime rollover. Large deltas/native wrap use injection.
Linux binaries compile/link only; full SDK/IRQ stack and full-game memory peaks remain unproven.
No game saves and no microSD I/O in N08.
